dict.string: Used to write FitSmarter links onto your own NFC stickers, so a tap can start your workout or open an exercise.
Used to talk to the Garmin watch you picked for FitSmarter, so your workout shows on your wrist and the sets you log there land on your iPhone.
Used to talk to the Garmin watch you picked for FitSmarter, so your workout shows on your wrist and the sets you log there land on your iPhone.
Used to scan your gym membership QR code, to take progress photos and photos or videos of exercises you add yourself, and to film a set so you can check your form.
Used to make sure it’s really you before your account is deleted.

Used to show your heart rate while you train, measured by your Apple Watch or by AirPods that track it, and, when you switch it on, to add the heart rate your watch saved, weigh-ins and the body fat and lean body mass from other apps to your log, to show your sleep, resting heart rate, heart rate variability and steps on this phone next to your training, to show the runs, rides and matches other apps saved in your calendar and recovery, to take the calories a watch measured during a workout you logged on the phone, and to use your birth date for your Apple Watch’s heart-rate zones.
Used to save your finished workouts (with the heart rate measured during them and an estimate of the calories they burned) and weigh-ins to Apple Health, when you switch it on.
Used to reach your own FitSmarter server or AI model on your home network, when you connect one.
Lets the gym reminder notice when you arrive at a gym you added, even with FitSmarter closed. iOS only watches those places, and your location never leaves this iPhone.
Used to put a gym on the map where you are standing, for the gym reminder. Your location stays on this iPhone.
Used to record the sound of a video you take of an exercise you add yourself or of a set you film, and the voice clips you record for the rest timer.
Used to save the pictures you make in FitSmarter, like your workout card or a progress comparison, to Photos. FitSmarter can only add pictures, never see your library.
